name: Being Vindictive
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate judge who defends the righteous against deceitful and unjust individuals, as seen in Psalms 43:1. While the proud and wicked face God's consuming judgment (Malachi 4:1), believers are called to submit to governing authorities established by God (Romans 13:1) and to embody the fruit of the Spirit, including love and gentleness (Galatians 5:22). God, the Creator and sovereign Lord over all, does not dwell in man-made temples but reigns supreme over heaven and earth (Acts 17:24), reminding us that vindictiveness belongs to God alone and Christians are to respond with Spirit-filled character rather than personal revenge.
